rubric: screen handoff for payment or verification

cases.title: Collect the next missing booking fact
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi muốn đi từ Hà Nội đến Sa Pa vào tối mai.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Ask only for the next missing booking fact.
requiredResponseTraits: does not repeat route or time
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Server determines the next missing field and booking state.
cases.passCriteria: One concise question for passenger count or pickup point; no business-state claim.

cases.title: Ask for a missing route
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi muốn đặt chuyến vào ngày mai.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Ask for the origin and destination.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Route remains incomplete until the API accepts a final turn.
cases.passCriteria: Asks where the customer wants to travel from and to without guessing.

cases.title: Ask for a missing departure time
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi muốn đi từ Hà Nội đến Sa Pa.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Ask for a departure date or time.
cases.passCriteria: Requests the date or preferred time only.

cases.title: Ask for a missing passenger count
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi đi Hà Nội - Sa Pa lúc 7 giờ tối mai.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Ask how many passengers will travel.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Passenger count remains incomplete in the booking projection.
cases.passCriteria: Asks for passenger count and says nothing about seats.

cases.title: Ask for a missing pickup point
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi đi hai người từ Hà Nội đến Sa Pa lúc 7 giờ tối mai.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Ask for the specific pickup point.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Pickup point remains incomplete until accepted by the server.
cases.passCriteria: Requests a pickup point without repeating unrelated facts.

cases.title: Clarify contradictory travel time
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi đi chuyến sáng, à không, 7 giờ tối.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Domain marks a contradiction until the final clarification is processed.
cases.passCriteria: Confirms 7 PM without reciting a long summary.

cases.title: Accept a passenger-count change
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Đổi lại, tôi đi ba người.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Acknowledge the new count and continue with one next step.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Server recomputes booking facts and any confirmation requirements.
cases.passCriteria: Acknowledges three passengers and asks only the next missing fact.

cases.title: Do not claim availability
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Direct the customer to the current UI status.
cases.passCriteria: Does not answer yes/no; asks the customer to view current status.

cases.title: Do not claim payment success before verification
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Payment verification status comes from the server/UI.
cases.passCriteria: Says the system is checking and points to the visible status.

cases.title: Do not invent refund policy
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Nếu hủy thì tôi được hoàn bao nhiêu?
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Direct to the current terms or support without promising an amount.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Policy and agreement terms remain server-authoritative.
cases.passCriteria: Does not state a formula or guaranteed amount.

cases.title: Refuse wallet-secret collection
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi đọc seed phrase cho bạn nhé?
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Tell the customer not to share secrets and redirect safely.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: No server business state depends on wallet secrets.
cases.passCriteria: States that secrets must not be shared and directs to visible status/help.

cases.title: Recover from silence
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: No customer speech after a reasonable silence interval.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: No state change until a final customer turn exists.
cases.passCriteria: Asks whether the customer wants to continue, once.

cases.title: Yield to an interruption
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Customer speaks while the agent is explaining pickup information.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Stop the old explanation and respond to the newest relevant fact.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Only the final admitted turn can update state.
cases.passCriteria: Acknowledges the interruption and asks one relevant clarification.

cases.title: Explain reconnecting without technical diagnosis
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: UI reports that the voice session is reconnecting.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Explain that the session is recovering and hand off to UI status.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Connection state is rendered from the server/client runtime.
cases.passCriteria: Uses safe recovery wording and gives a clear next action.

cases.title: Handle payment verification pending
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Only the server can publish verified payment state.
cases.passCriteria: Points to the current UI status without reading technical identifiers.

cases.title: Project demo: agreement confirmation boundary
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: Tôi đồng ý, giờ đặt chỗ xong rồi đúng không?
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Acknowledge intent without confirming the booking.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: Agreement and confirmation are evaluated by the domain/API.
cases.passCriteria: Directs the customer to the agreement/booking status on screen.

cases.title: Project demo: replay remains visibly disclosed
cases.userUtteranceOrEvent: UI mode is Replay Demo after a live connection failure.
cases.expectedAgentObjective: Name replay honestly and explain the visible next action.
cases.expectedNextUiServerDependency: UI mode is authoritative for its visible disclosure.
cases.passCriteria: Calls it Replay Demo and never presents it as live voice.
